errors.error_description: Used logical AND (&&) between 32-bit vectors for the AND operation instead of bitwise AND (&), causing boolean reduction semantics.
Procedurally assigned to an input port inside the module, violating port directionality rules.
Mixed blocking (=) and non-blocking (<=) assignments within the same clocked always_ff block, introducing a race.
Declared a local signal that is never read or driven, making it an unused signal.
